title: Transcendence degree of a field extension
statement: Let $K\subseteq L$ be a field extension (more generally, let $A$ be a commutative algebra over a commutative ring $K$). A family of elements of $L$ is *algebraically independent* over $K$ if no nonzero polynomial with coefficients in $K$ vanishes on it. The *transcendence degree* $\operatorname{trdeg}_KL$ is the supremum of the cardinalities of the subsets of $L$ that are algebraically independent over $K$; for a field extension it equals the cardinality of any transcendence basis of $L$ over $K$. In particular $\operatorname{trdeg}_KL\le a$ for an integer $a\ge0$ means that every algebraically independent subset of $L$ has at most $a$ elements.
